name: refund-policy.md
content: Enterprise customers have a 45-day refund window. Standard customers have a 14-day refund window. Refunds return to the original payment method.

name: security-handbook.md
content: All employees must use multi-factor authentication. Security incidents must be reported within one hour. Customer exports are retained for 30 days.

name: leave-policy.md
content: Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual leave. Parental leave is 16 weeks. Leave requests require manager approval.

name: travel-policy.md
content: Flights under six hours must be economy class. Hotel reimbursement is capped at 250 dollars per night. Receipts are required above 25 dollars.

name: support-sla.md
content: Critical incidents have a 15-minute first-response target. High priority tickets target two hours. Standard tickets target one business day.

name: data-classification.md
content: Data is classified as public, internal, confidential, or restricted. Restricted data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

name: vendor-policy.md
content: Vendors handling personal data require a security review. Contracts above 50000 dollars require legal approval. Reviews renew annually.

name: onboarding.md
content: New hires complete security training in their first week. Equipment requests are submitted before the start date. Benefits enrollment closes after 30 days.

name: expense-policy.md
content: Expense reports are due within 10 business days. Meals are capped at 75 dollars per day. Alcohol is not reimbursable.

name: continuity-plan.md
content: The recovery time objective is four hours. Backups run every six hours. Disaster recovery exercises occur twice each year.
